fields.description:
# RF-1: Referrer Object + Core Status

_Foundational Referrer object — the status picklist and the counts/BA lookup everything else on this record depends on._

### FIELDS

* Referrer Status — Picklist: Active, Inactive, Paused, Banned

* Swaps Player's Pending for Paused — Joyce Kiddell, [1:29:26](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=5366): “Because you can't pause a player, but refer would have active, inactive, paused, banned.”

* Assigned Brand Ambassador — Lookup to Brand Ambassador, required

* No BA means this referrer is invisible to BA-level and Manager-level reporting.

* Primary Referrals — count flow?
* Secondary Referrals — count flow?

### IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS

* BAs see only their own assigned Referrers, plus Referrers of BAs below them in the manager hierarchy

* Sharing-rule/permission design, not a field — Kobi Kunasekaran, [1:39:48](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=5988): “as long as the BA is assigned to the referrer, they can see it.” Lina Ceniccola, [1:39:56](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=5996): “Unless they're a manager of the BA, then they can see.”

* Missing-BA banner copy not re-confirmed

* Not confirmed in the transcript — sourced from the prototype's help text only.

* Primary Referrals / Secondary Referrals counts need Flow-based automation, not a native Roll-Up Summary field

* The Sign Up → Referrer relationship uses Lookup fields, so Roll-Up Summary is not available. See [BUILD-238 — Referrer: Primary/Secondary Referrals Roll-Up Automation](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217870569060418/f/) for the automation build.

### NOTES

* Provenance: RF-1 (Referrer Record User Stories doc).

### SOURCE

* [Taryn doc RF-1 — Referrer Record User Stories](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MsJXwt3oY-DyQuAdMzNYlyPenKUQl7g8mHzMmeRaVHs/edit?tab=t.lh55xwl5syhi)
* [Aug 18 Weekly Sync — Joyce Kiddell, 1:29:26 (status swap)](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=5366)
* [Aug 18 Weekly Sync — Kobi Kunasekaran, 1:39:48 (BA visibility)](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=5988)
* [Aug 18 Weekly Sync — Lina Ceniccola, 1:39:56 (manager hierarchy)](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=5996)
* Dependencies: [BUILD-238 — Referrer: Primary/Secondary Referrals Roll-Up Automation](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217870569060418/f/)
* Owner (proposed): Taryn Reithofer
* Created 2026-08-20 from Referrer record documentation review.
